parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline two common compulsions of body dysmorphic disorder (BDD).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the psychodynamic explanation for obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the psychodynamic explanation for OCD
and genetic explanations for OCD.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the treatment and management of impulse control disorders and non-substance
addictive disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of impulse control disorders and non-substance
addictive disorder, including a discussion of nature versus nurture. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline ‘behaviour constraint’ in consumer theories of personal space.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe Study 2 (the field experiment) by Dayan and Bar-Hillel (2011) about primacy,
recency and menu item position.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the study by Dayan and Bar-Hillel.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about consumer decision-making (models,
strategies, marketing theories).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about consumer decision-making (models,
strategies, marketing theories), including a discussion of generalisations. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify two recording devices that give physiological measures of stress.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the study about psychological measures of stress by Friedman and Rosenman
(1974).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two weaknesses of the study by Friedman and Rosenman.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about strategies for promoting health (fear
arousal, Yale model of communication, providing information).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about strategies for promoting health (fear
arousal, Yale model of communication, providing information), including a discussion of
quantitative and qualitative data. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify two qualities of good followers (Kelley, 1988).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe situational leadership (Hersey and Blanchard, 1988).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of situational leadership.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about cognitive theories of motivation to work
(goal-setting theory, VIE theory, equity theory).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about cognitive theories of motivation to work
(goal-setting theory, VIE theory, equity theory), including a discussion of individual and
situational explanations.
